key_insight: SOLARPROP 2.0 modernizes solar modulation modeling by adding full 2D/3D stochastic transport equations, major speedups, and easier Python-based access.
engineering_relevance: It provides a faster, more flexible open-source tool for researchers modeling charge-sign dependent cosmic-ray transport in the heliosphere.
method: Converted the charged-particle transport equation into stochastic differential equations (SDEs).
Extended the solver to full 2D SDEs with latitudinal magnetic-field components and generalized it to 3D.
Applied parallelization and code optimization, plus Python bindings for usability.
evidence_signal: The updated code was validated against multiple literature models, showing excellent agreement in many cases and highlighting discrepancies in two implementations.
watch_item: Model-to-model differences remain for some implementations, so results should be checked carefully against the chosen reference setup.
paper_title: Solarprop 2.0: Modern charge-sign dependent solar modulation for everyone
